memory.text: When implementing SSR with React, use renderToString on the server and hydrateRoot on the client. Key decision: stream vs string rendering depends on TTFB requirements.
Async Python with FastAPI: use httpx for async HTTP calls, avoid mixing sync and async database drivers. asyncpg outperforms psycopg2 for PostgreSQL.
Multi-stage Docker builds reduce image size by 60-80%. Use builder stage for compilation, copy only artifacts to slim runtime image.
Trunk-based development with short-lived feature branches. Squash merge to main. Rebase before merge to keep linear history.
Testing pyramid: 70% unit tests, 20% integration, 10% e2e. Use pytest fixtures for shared setup. Mock external services at the HTTP layer.
Custom exception hierarchy in Python: BaseAppError > ValidationError, NotFoundError, AuthError. Each maps to an HTTP status code.
Redis caching with TTL: cache database queries for 5min, API responses for 1min. Use cache-aside pattern. Invalidate on write.
REST API versioning: URL prefix /v1/ is simplest. Use HATEOAS for discoverability. Pagination via cursor, not offset.
Security headers checklist: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options DENY, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff.
Alembic migrations: always create a downgrade path. Test migrations on a copy of production data. Never modify a deployed migration.
WebSocket reconnection: exponential backoff starting at 1s, max 30s. Send heartbeat pings every 30s. Handle close codes 1000 vs 1006 differently.
CI pipeline order: lint > type-check > unit tests > build > integration tests > deploy. Fail fast on lint to save compute.
Structured logging with JSON output. Include request_id, user_id, duration_ms. Use log levels: DEBUG for dev, INFO for prod, ERROR for alerts.
Environment config: use pydantic-settings to load from .env files with type validation. Never commit .env files. Use .env.example as template.
Rate limiting strategy: token bucket for API endpoints, sliding window for auth attempts. Return Retry-After header with 429 responses.
